methodology: Cross-referenced data from 7 prior sprints (S5-S12) plus fresh scans via StatShow, Responsify/Semrush, SimilarWeb, and web search. DataForSEO account depleted ($-0.03 balance). Ahrefs/Moz/Semrush/HypeStat all block automated access via Cloudflare/JS rendering. One verified Moz DA (fitocracy DA 3 via Puppeteer S7). Three Ahrefs DR values verified in prior sprints (devhub.io DR 27, mortgagecalc.com DR 6, seochecker.com DR 1.3). Builder.ai DR 68 from metrics_ranked.json tagged as ahrefs_verified. OpenRank.io API returns 404 (no public REST API). OpenPageRank requires API key (not available). Sprint 7 established definitively: bulk DA/DR requires paid API subscription ($29-129/mo).

critical_note: As confirmed in Sprint 7: DA/DR metrics CANNOT be obtained for free at scale. Every free web tool renders results via JavaScript behind Cloudflare. A paid Moz ($29/mo), Ahrefs ($99/mo), or SEMrush ($129/mo) subscription is REQUIRED for reliable bulk DA/DR verification. The numbers below combine the best available data from 7 sprints of multi-tool cross-validation.
